title: SF Apartment Finder
claim: Product Hunt: SF Apartment Finder — Tinder for live SF rentals from across the web
why_good: The platform leverages real-time data aggregation and user preferences to streamline the apartment hunting process, addressing a significant pain point in a competitive market.
value: Landlords and property management companies can pay for premium listings and analytics on user engagement, while renters could be charged for additional features like personalized alerts.
risk: The startup may struggle against established real estate platforms that could easily integrate similar features or acquire the technology.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
